title: Active Spiking Perception: The Membrane Potential as a Belief State for Anytime 3D Point Cloud Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.19232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spiking point cloud networks usually scan space in a fixed, input-agnostic order, which leaves the most distinctive resource of spiking computation, the temporal evolution of the membrane potential, unused as a locus of decision-making. Active Spiking Perception (ASP) recasts 3D recognition as an iterative decision process in which the network's own leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) membrane potential, read as a running belief over the class, selects the next chunk to observe and triggers confidence-margin early exit. A lightweight Slice-Selection Policy scores unvisited farthest-point-sampled chunks from the membrane state and precomputed geometric descriptors, trains end-to-end through a straight-through Gumbel-Softmax, reduces to an argmax at inference, and adds about 2% of backbone parameters. We prove that leaky integration is the recursive log-posterior update of a Bayesian filter, that the exit rule attains distribution-free select

translated_title: 主动尖峰感知：膜电位作为任意时间三维点云识别的信念状态
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19232v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尖峰点云网络通常以固定、与输入无关的顺序扫描空间，这留下了尖峰计算最独特的资源——膜电位的时间演化——未作为决策的场所。主动尖峰感知（ASP）将三维识别重新构建为迭代决策过程，其中网络自身的漏电整合-发放（LIF）膜电位，作为类别的运行信念读取，选择下一个要观察的块，并触发置信度边际的提前退出。一个轻量级的切片选择策略从膜状态和预计算的几何描述符中评分未访问的最远点采样块，通过直通Gumbel-Softmax进行端到端训练，在推理时简化为argmax，并增加约2%的骨干网络参数。我们证明漏电积分是贝叶斯滤波器的递归对数后验更新，退出规则达到无分布选择性。
tldr: 本文提出主动尖峰感知（ASP）方法，利用膜电位作为信念状态，通过迭代决策和提前退出机制，实现高效且自适应的三维点云识别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Active Spiking Perception (ASP), which leverages membrane potential as a belief state for iterative decision-making and early exit, enabling efficient and adaptive 3D point cloud recognition.
